provenance: Measured by forge/leaf-windows.mjs off the store's own ms-page files. The window is the photolithographic plate's rectangle on the printed sheet, read from the tone of its paper against the sheet's white; the pan still reaches the whole sheet.
method: row and column medians at 200 samples across, 8 levels under the sheet's own white, bridging 3 samples, 0.004 of the axis kept around the plate, a reading under 0.88 of the edition's median plate refused
